_comment: What you can text back, and when.
MATCHED ON WORDS RATHER THAN ON A TOPIC LIST. Messages in this mod are written by a
dozen different systems and none of them files a category with the text -- there is a
sender, a subject and a body, and that is all. So a set claims the words it answers and
the first set with a word in the last thing they said is the one that answers it.
Ordered top to bottom: the specific ones first, because "ballas outside right now"
contains both a fight and a summons and the fight is the thing worth answering.
when     lowercase words looked for anywhere in the subject or the body
lines    what you might send. One is picked at random.
back     what they might say to that, if anything. Empty means the last word is yours.
TONE IS PER SET AND ON PURPOSE. Somebody telling you their spot got hit does not want a
joke back; somebody asking where you are at four in the morning is fair game. The sets
near the top are the serious ones and it shows.

sets._: Somebody is being shot at. Nothing funny in here.
lines: on my way. dont do nothing stupid til i get there

sets._: Come here, where are you, get down here. Half serious, half excuses.
lines: i was on my way when you sent that
im round the corner. been round the corner a while
i can hear you from here
back: you said that an hour ago

sets._: Money owed, and every way of not saying no.
lines: im workin on it right now as we speak
it was like that when i found it
that thing was fine when i parked it
back: its here when you want it

sets._: The takeover and anything on Carson.
lines: on my way. save me a spot
how long they been sittin there
i been inside all day. thats my story

sets._: The house, the block, coming home.
Somebody just being rude, which deserves an answer in kind.
